quotes.speaker: AJ Green
quotes.summary_phrase: AJ Green on Milwaukee's defensive impact in the second half
quotes.excerpt: our defensive impact in the second half really got us going
quotes.quote: I think our defensive impact in the second half really got us going, starting on ball. Boston is so good at getting to multiple actions and making you chase. We were doing that in the first half and I think being able to slow them up a little bit with our on-ball presence helped us. Then we were able to string some stops together and get going offensively. So I think that could be a good carryover going forward, build off of that.
quotes.social_post: AJ Green says the Bucks defensive impact in the second half against Boston is a blueprint for the team. He believes their on ball pressure helped slow down the Celtics and is something they can carry over into future games.

structured.context: AJ Green discusses how the team's defensive intensity in the second half against Boston helped their offensive performance.

quotes.speaker: AJ Green
quotes.summary_phrase: AJ Green on the importance of defensive intensity for offensive rhythm
quotes.excerpt: shots start falling because you get lost in the game, just competing
quotes.quote: Shots start falling because you get lost in the game, just competing. I think it was our defense where you're not even worried about that. That's just you're playing, now you're competing and shots are just going to go. And so I think it absolutely can carry over game to game, but just focusing on impacting winning and helping gets everybody just lost in the game.
quotes.social_post: AJ Green on the Bucks offensive rhythm. He believes shots start falling when the team stops worrying about the result and gets lost in the game by focusing entirely on defensive intensity and competing.

structured.context: AJ Green explains how defensive focus allows players to get lost in the game and improve their offensive rhythm.

quotes.speaker: AJ Green
quotes.summary_phrase: AJ Green on the team's need to compete from the jump
quotes.excerpt: we can't rely on that and wait on that, you know, every game
quotes.quote: We got to just bring it and compete, play super hard and just trust that. And that's got to be our identity and that's going to get us going night after night for 48 minutes. So you know there's some of that at halftime, but we can't rely on that and wait on that, you know, every game. It's got to be from the jump where we bring that that go each night.
quotes.social_post: AJ Green says the Bucks need to establish a consistent identity from the jump. He admits the team cannot rely on halftime adjustments to spark their energy and must bring a competitive effort for all 48 minutes every night.

structured.context: AJ Green emphasizes the need for the team to establish a consistent identity by competing hard from the start of every game.

quotes.speaker: AJ Green
quotes.summary_phrase: AJ Green on the challenge of maintaining consistent motivation
quotes.excerpt: you can't just be motivated, like you are motivated by that, but you can't rely on those things
quotes.quote: I think the hard thing is you can't just be motivated, like you are motivated by that, but you can't rely on those things like, oh tonight we're going to decide to play. And I think when we won it, it was just knowing obviously what we were playing for, but focusing on us and just taking it one game at a time. Just win tonight. I think we did that well with that team that got that that cup out in Vegas.
quotes.social_post: AJ Green discusses the challenge of maintaining motivation. He emphasizes that the team cannot pick and choose when to play hard and must focus on taking it one game at a time to find consistency.

structured.context: AJ Green discusses the challenge of maintaining consistent motivation and the importance of focusing on individual games.

quotes.speaker: AJ Green
quotes.summary_phrase: AJ Green on team spirit and resilience despite early losses
quotes.excerpt: our spirit is still great, our joy, our togetherness is still there
quotes.quote: There's a lot of basketball still left in the season and it's just the start and we've made strides. It's just a matter of doing it for 48 minutes and being consistent with it. And so I think our spirit is still great, our joy, our togetherness is still there and you know, hopefully regardless of what happens, it's only going to come together even more, whether it's through adversity or good times. Hope all of it brings us together.
quotes.social_post: Despite the early season struggles, AJ Green says the spirit and togetherness of the Bucks remain strong. He believes the team will continue to grow closer through both the adversity and the good times ahead.

structured.context: AJ Green reflects on the team's resilience and togetherness early in the season despite recent losses.
